tpl_ask_tpl: This action will delete the template permanently.
tpl_ask_line: This action will delete the line from the template.
tpl_edit_tip: Template settings: name, picture, copy, delete, lines
tpl_shot_tip: Takes a new picture of the template: the scene as the camera sees it now, without the interface. Move the camera first.
tpl_line_del: Remove this line from the template
set_help_tip: Shows which keys and mouse buttons to use
help_text:
Selecting segments
Click: select one segment (the previous selection is dropped)
Shift + click: the whole connected quay
Ctrl + click: add a segment to the selection or remove it
Ctrl + Shift + click: add or remove the whole quay
Right click: clear the selection; right click again: leave the tool

Hotkeys
{act}: open and close the Quay Tools window (the key is set in the mod options)
{flip} over a quay: flip the segment, no tool needed (the key is set in the mod options)
{flip} + Shift: flip the whole connected quay
Ctrl + Z / Ctrl + Y (or Ctrl + Shift + Z): undo / redo while the window is open (can be turned off in the mod options)

Values
Double click on a slider: reset the value
A value can be typed in the field next to the slider

Lists
Type in the search field to filter; the star marks a favourite (favourites come first)

Window
Drag the window by its title.
The pencil next to a template opens its settings
hint_settings: Options of Quay Tools, the controls help and the button that clears all edited quays on the current map.
set_clear_tip: Clears all edited quays on the current map. Removes from every segment: network-lines, props-lines, texture-paths, locks of the orientation, removed pedestrian paths and hidden default props. Nothing else is touched: the quays themselves, roads and the game's own fences stay, flipped segments stay flipped, and the template files are kept. Asks for a confirmation first. Undo brings everything back.
clear_all_ask: This action will clear all edited quays on the current map.
seg_clear_tip: Removes everything of Quay Tools from the selected segments: network-lines, props-lines, texture-paths, the orientation lock, the removed pedestrian path and hidden default props. The inversion stays. Undo brings everything back.
clear_all_none: There are no modifications to remove
hint_tpl: Save the lines of a segment (network-lines, props-lines, texture-paths) as a template and apply it to other segments. Select segments: the template is saved from the first selected segment and applied to all selected ones, replacing their lines. Undo restores them.
tpl_name_tip: Name of the new template (the characters / \ : * ? " < > | are not allowed)
tpl_save_tip: Saves the models and values of all lines and paths of the first selected segment, with a picture of the scene (no interface). The start / end trims are saved as a share of the segment length.
tpl_apply_tip: Replaces all network-lines, props-lines and texture-paths of the selected segments with the ones of the template. Undo restores them.
tpl_folder_tip: Opens the folder with the template files
tpl_noname: Type a name for the template first
tpl_empty: The segment has no lines to save
tpl_save_failed: Could not save the template file
tpl_delete_failed: Could not delete the template file
hint_segment: Select quay segments, then use the buttons and switches: invert the direction, lock the orientation, remove the pedestrian path, hide the default props. Segments with a lock, no pedestrian path or hidden props are red.
seg_invert_tip: Flips the direction of the selected segments (press again to flip back).
seg_lock_tip: The game and other mods can no longer flip the selected segments.
seg_nop_tip: Citizens do not walk on the selected segments.
seg_hide_tip: Hides the props that come with the quay model (lights, trees, benches). Your own Props-line props stay.
hint_hideprops: Select quay segments and press the button. The props that come with the quay model, such as lights, trees and benches, are hidden on them. Your own prop lines stay. Hidden segments are red.
hp_note: Only the props of the network model itself are hidden. Props placed with Props-line stay. The change applies to the selected segments only, not to other segments of the same quay type.
mode_network: Network-line: network models along the quay
hint_props: Select quay segments, press Add prop line, choose a prop and tune it.
hint_lock: Select quay segments and press Lock. The game and other mods can no longer flip them. Locked segments are red.
lock_note: A locked segment keeps its orientation: if the game or another mod flips it, it is flipped back at once. The Invert tool of Quay Tools still works and the lock keeps the new orientation.
prop_search_tip: Type part of a name to search
prop_nolines: No prop lines on the selection
ptilt_tip: The prop leans with the height curve of the quay (up and down slopes) instead of standing level.
hint_nopeds: Select quay segments and press the button. Pedestrians will not walk on them and will not see them as a path. Blocked segments are red.
nop_note: The pathfinder skips these segments, so citizens neither route over them nor see them as a path. Citizens whose route already crosses one get a new route. Every path that may use pedestrian lanes avoids them, vehicle-only paths are not affected. Use it only on pedestrian quays.
dstrip_tip: Plane: one textured strip instead of placed decals, lit when the tint is opaque. The way is chosen when the path is added.
hidehl_tip: The highlight of quay borders and lines is hidden while a slider is dragged
hint_invert: Click a quay to flip it. Shift flips the whole connected quay.
hint_network: Select quay segments, press Add Network model, choose a model and tune it.
hint_decal: Select quay segments, press Add decal or Add plane, choose a texture and tune the path.
typehint: Type a value in metres (Enter). Limit: +-{0}
failed: Action failed, see the game log
star_tip: Favourite: shown first in the list
reset_tip: Reset the values of the lines of the selected segments to defaults
dcolormul_tip: 0: the tint works the way the game applies it (only where the decal allows a colour). 1: the colour covers the whole texture (a white tint gives a white decal). Works for decals and planes.
o_show_wn_tip: Shows the "What's new" window once after the mod has been updated to a new version.
o_key_activate_tip: Opens and closes Quay Tools. Click the field and press the new key combination (Esc cancels).
o_key_flip_tip: Flips the segment under the cursor without the tool; with Shift held the whole connected quay. Click the field and press the new key (Esc cancels).
o_s_hidetips_tip: Hides the tooltips of the Quay Tools window.
o_compat_tip: This function only detects compatibility issues for this mod.
o_reset_tip: Warning! This resets all settings of this mod and cannot be undone.
o_reset_ask: All Quay Tools settings will be set back to their defaults.
o_c_ver_ok: The mod was tested with this game version ({0}).
o_c_ver_bad: The mod was tested with {0}, your game is {1}.
o_exp_text: This setting is experimental and has not been tested properly. The tools may behave unexpectedly on roads and other networks. Turn it off if something goes wrong.
opt_quickflip: Enable quick-flip hotkey (Ctrl + key over a quay, no tool needed)
opt_swap: Swap land/water sides for fences (use only if fences go to the wrong side everywhere)
opt_undokeys: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo while the Quay Tools window is open (turn off if it clashes with another undo mod)
opt_shadows: Texture-path strips receive shadows (lit shader; turn off for the unlit look if the colours look wrong)
opt_bridge: Texture and prop paths: at sharp bends of nodes (Node Controller Renewal) bridge the gap along the centre line
opt_mark: While the tool is active, highlight edited segments and show tool icons above them
opt_iconsize: Size of the floating tool icons above edited segments
opt_anynet: Allow tools on any network segment (not only quays)
